promoted_control.result: The exact one-to-three-row Q4_K kernel improved shape-matched MTP2 accepted throughput by 1.148x with token parity.

fast_but_arithmetic_changing_negative.result: Ordinary row-major requantization removed token-zero collapse and exposed a 1.129x MTP3 diagnostic, but changed trajectories and missed its frozen graph gate.

native_gemm_rewrite_negative.result: An algebra-preserving native GEMM lane rewrite improved the four-row graph by only 1.0231x and was rejected.

hypothesis: The useful speed in the rejected row-major four-row kernel came from sharing each Q4_K weight decode across four output rows, not from changing activation quantization. Exactly deinterleaving the already-quantized native block_q8_Kx4 buffer into four ordinary block_q8_K views once per operator, then calling the fused four-accumulator AVX2 kernel, should retain native Q8_K codes, scales, and sums while recovering most of that speed ceiling.

forbidden_changes: No float-to-Q8_K requantization is allowed after native block_q8_Kx4 production.
No Q4_K weight, model file, tokenizer, sampler, draft model, or cache representation may change.
No path outside exact-four-row Q4_K 8x8 matrix multiplication may change.
No high-precision activation or weight materialization may be introduced.
layout_contract.workspace: One bounded Q8_K-sized transient buffer is allowed. It must be allocated by the graph workspace contract, populated once after native quantization, shared read-only by worker threads, and included in memory receipts.

implementation.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order ragged dispatch v1 and promoted fused one-to-three-row AVX2 v2
implementation.candidate: The base plus the rejected v3 four-accumulator arithmetic, repaired by a byte-exact native block_q8_Kx4 deinterleave before dispatch.

stop_rules: Reject immediately if the byte-defined layout inverse or any backend reference case fails.
Reject before generation if the paired graph speedup is below 1.10x or stability/frequency gates fail.
Reject if the unchanged target-only path changes tokens, collapses, or regresses by more than two percent.
Reject if MTP3 accepted throughput improves by less than five percent.
Reject if the frozen CUTE or WikiText capability gate fails; do not excuse a quality failure as floating-point reassociation.
Record a terminal negative instead of tuning thresholds after observation.
promotion_boundary: A pass promotes one same-weights AVX2 exact-four-row Q4_K verification kernel on four Milan cores. It does not establish the 2.75 tok/s conventional-decode breakthrough gate, a trained approximation, final-node scaling, energy benefit, 100 accepted tokens per second, or scientific novelty.
